name: Otter.ai
description: Otter's MCP Server integrates with Otter.ai's meeting intelligence platform, enabling users to search meeting transcripts, retrieve conversation records, and extract insights. It provides tools to find meetings by date, participants, or topics, and access full transcripts, summaries, and action items. This helps teams review past discussions and prepare for meetings without leaving Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Otter.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Otter.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.otter.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Otter.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Otter.ai provides these MCP tools: get_user_info, search, and fetch.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Otter.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Otter.ai in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Otter.ai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Otter.ai is developed by Otter.ai. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
